label: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs
blurb: A focused six-fact drill set for Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs.

topics.title: ISRO SpaDeX docking
topics.hook: On 16 January 2025, ISRO docked the two SpaDeX satellites and made India the fourth country to demonstrate space docking.
topics.explainer: ISRO completed the first SpaDeX docking on 16 January 2025. The mission demonstrated rendezvous, docking and power-transfer capabilities needed for future Indian space stations and sample-return missions.
topics.category: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs

connections.relationship: Indian docking and NASA survey missions in 2025
connections.fact: SpaDeX demonstrated two spacecraft joining in orbit on 16 January; SPHEREx began an all-sky infrared survey after its 11 March launch.
SpaDeX made India the fourth nation to demonstrate docking, while Euclid's March release opened European survey catalogues to researchers.

topics.title: Microsoft Majorana 1
topics.hook: Microsoft announced Majorana 1 on 19 February 2025 as a quantum chip built around its claimed topological-core architecture.
topics.explainer: Majorana 1 was unveiled by Microsoft on 19 February 2025. Its significance is the company’s topological-qubit approach, intended to make quantum systems easier to scale and control.
topics.category: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs

connections.fact: Microsoft presented Majorana 1 for quantum computing in February; IBM presented the Telum II-powered z17 for enterprise AI in April.
Majorana 1 targets topological qubits, whereas NVIDIA's Blackwell GPUs target graphics and AI workloads.

topics.title: NASA SPHEREx launch
topics.hook: NASA launched the SPHEREx observatory on 11 March 2025 to map the whole sky in 102 infrared colours.
topics.explainer: SPHEREx launched on 11 March 2025. Its all-sky spectroscopic survey studies cosmic inflation, galaxy evolution and the distribution of water and organic molecules in the Milky Way.
topics.category: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs

connections.fact: SPHEREx maps the full sky spectroscopically, while Euclid maps galaxies to study dark matter, dark energy, and cosmic structure.
ISRO docked SpaDeX in January 2025, nearly two months before NASA launched SPHEREx in March.

topics.title: IBM z17 mainframe
topics.hook: IBM announced the AI-focused z17 mainframe on 8 April 2025, powered by the Telum II processor.
topics.explainer: IBM introduced z17 on 8 April 2025. It pairs the Telum II processor with on-chip AI acceleration so enterprises can score transactions for fraud and other risks with low latency.
topics.category: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs

connections.relationship: AI acceleration in different computer markets
connections.fact: IBM z17 embeds Telum II acceleration for enterprise transactions; RTX 50 GPUs use Blackwell for consumer graphics and neural rendering.

connections.relationship: Classical enterprise processor versus quantum claim
connections.fact: The z17 is a commercial mainframe using conventional silicon, unlike Microsoft's experimental topological-quantum architecture.

topics.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series
topics.hook: NVIDIA unveiled the Blackwell-based GeForce RTX 50 series at CES on 6 January 2025.
topics.explainer: The GeForce RTX 50 series debuted on 6 January 2025 using NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture. The launch emphasized neural rendering, including the DLSS 4 family of AI-assisted graphics techniques.
topics.category: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs

connections.relationship: Blackwell graphics and Telum enterprise systems
connections.fact: Both announcements highlighted AI acceleration, but NVIDIA addressed GPUs and gaming while IBM addressed mainframe transactions.
RTX 50 products use classical GPU architecture; Majorana 1 was presented as a route toward scalable topological quantum computing.

topics.title: Euclid first data release
topics.hook: ESA released Euclid mission survey data for the first time on 19 March 2025, including deep-field previews and source catalogues.
topics.explainer: Euclid’s first survey-data release arrived on 19 March 2025. The mission maps galaxies across cosmic time to investigate dark matter, dark energy and the large-scale structure of the Universe.
topics.category: Current Technology, Science and Business Affairs

connections.fact: Euclid studies large-scale galaxy structure while SPHEREx obtains an all-sky infrared spectral map.

connections.relationship: European data release and Indian docking result
connections.fact: Both were 2025 space milestones, but Euclid released survey data and SpaDeX demonstrated orbital rendezvous and docking.

questions.q: Which country became the fourth to demonstrate in-space docking on 16 January 2025?
options: Europe through the Automated Transfer Vehicle
questions.explanation: ISRO docked the two SpaDeX spacecraft on 16 January 2025, demonstrating rendezvous and docking technology needed for complex future missions.

questions.q: Which company announced the Majorana 1 quantum chip on 19 February 2025?
questions.explanation: Microsoft presented Majorana 1 in February 2025 around a claimed topological-core architecture aimed at more scalable qubits.

questions.q: What was SPHEREx launched to map after 11 March 2025?
options: The whole sky in 102 infrared colours
The distribution of dark matter from galaxy shapes
The Sun’s corona in visible light
questions.explanation: NASA's 2025 SPHEREx mission performs all-sky spectroscopy to study cosmic history, galaxies, and water-bearing molecules.

questions.q: Which processor powers the AI-focused IBM z17 announced on 8 April 2025?
questions.explanation: IBM paired the 2025 z17 mainframe with Telum II so AI inference can occur close to high-volume enterprise transactions.

questions.q: At CES on 6 January 2025, NVIDIA unveiled which Blackwell-based consumer line?
questions.explanation: The GeForce RTX 50 series brought NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture and DLSS 4 neural-rendering features to the 2025 gaming market.

questions.q: Which European mission issued its first survey-data release on 19 March 2025?
questions.explanation: ESA's Euclid release in March 2025 included deep-field previews and catalogues for research on dark matter and dark energy.

questions.q: Place the 2025 events in order: RTX 50 unveiling, SpaDeX docking, Majorana 1 announcement.
questions.explanation: NVIDIA announced RTX 50 on 6 January 2025, ISRO docked SpaDeX on 16 January, and Microsoft unveiled Majorana 1 on 19 February.

questions.q: Which 2025 chip pairing is matched to the correct purpose?
questions.explanation: Microsoft linked Majorana 1 to topological qubits in 2025; Telum II and Blackwell are classical processor architectures for different markets.

questions.q: Which comparison between the two March 2025 space milestones is correct?
options: SPHEREx launched; Euclid released survey data
Euclid launched; SPHEREx completed a survey-data release
Both missions launched on the same day
Both missions released their first survey catalogues
questions.explanation: NASA launched SPHEREx on 11 March 2025, while ESA opened Euclid's first survey-data treasure trove on 19 March.

questions.q: A bank wants low-latency fraud scoring on a 2025 enterprise mainframe. Which announcement is most relevant?
options: NVIDIA DGX system with Blackwell GPUs
questions.explanation: The April 2025 z17 announcement emphasised on-chip AI inference for transaction-heavy enterprise workloads such as real-time fraud detection.
